notes.title: Book of Unwritten Tales 2 Patch Released!
notes.content:
Here is the changelog:
• Added additional sidequest in Chapter 5
• Added achievements for the sidequests in Chapter 4
• Fixed a bug with the sandbag in chapter 3
• Fixed missing inventory icons
• Fixed a bug where the credits didn’t show up 
• Fixed gaps in the background 
• Fixed a bug where the subtitles didn’t show up in minigames
• Performance improvements in some scenes (which caused the Critter bug in chapter 2) 
• Fixed a bug where the music didn’t stop playing in chapter 5
• Fixed interaction points with controller input
• Fixed bugs where the zoom didn’t reset after a dialogue
• Fixed a bug where Nate disappears when switching characters in chapter 4
• Fixed some minor issues in chapter 5

Please provide feedback here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/279940/discussions/0/617330406660564683/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Early Access Chapter 4 - Feb 2015 Update
notes.content:
Before the release there is another Early Access update live now!
We've done some more polishing, fixed a few minor bugs and the bug that stopped some players from giving Ivo's mother the mirror.
Moreover (insert drum roll here): all optional Sidequests for the first four chapters are now unlocked! Have fun exploring! ;)

We are looking forward to any feedback!

notes.title: Early Access Chapter 4 - Jan 2015 Update
notes.content:
Hello,

We just released another update to greatly improve Book of Unwritten Tales 2.
Here is the complete changelog:
- Fixed a total of over 700 bugs
- Fixed a bug causing the game to be stuck
- fixed pathfinding problems in the tomb
- depth of field effects added in ultra quality setting
- memory usage optimized
- speech bugs fixed
- mismatching subtitles corrected
- various sound effects bugs fixed
- additional sound effects added
- clipping revised, movement areas optimized
- camera scrolling adjusted
- various focus problems fixed
- size and position of some click objects adjusted
- Translation errors fixed
- missing speech files added
- various animation flaws fixed
- screen area adjusted for different aspect ratios
- various sequences sped up by enabling parallel playback of dialogue and animations
- various geometry bugs fixed
- texture bugs fixed
- NavMeshes adjusted
- zoom and blur added to various dialogues
- outfits are carried over from previous chapters
- more idle animation variations of characters
- missing inventory icons added
- missing mouth movement included and improved
- staging of various scenes improved and sped up
- missing music added

Thanks to all the helpful reports!

notes.title: Early Access & Chapter 3 Update November 17th
notes.content:
- New, improved controls via controller.
- Fixed camera behavior.
- Optimized display of credits.
- Fixed a bug where avatar was teleporting instead of walking.

3.1:
· Adjusted diverse MouseOver texts and states.
· The scene where Esther and Ethel enter the workshop with the paint works now.
· Adjusted background in the workshop.
· Adjusted camera in the camp.
· Getting coal last doesn’t result in a dead end any more.
· Rope with stone/sack disappears from inventory when used.
· Fixed several problems with Timmy’s disguise.
· Some objects that could only be examined once, can now be examined more than once.
· Fixed dead end during assembly of the detonation mechanism.
· Added missing inventory icon at detonation mechanism.

3.2:
· If Ivo examines doll for the second time, the examine sequence from the first time won’t be played again.
· Esther and Gulliver can now be examined more than once.
· Fixed wrong examine sequence after Ivo has been freed from prison.
· Fixed problem with coal and poster.
· Fixed problem of game freezing after talking to Ethel about healing potion.
· Fixed dead end when Wilbur is entering school while Ivo is standing next to troll.
· Fixed NavMesh problems in the lake scene.

NOTE: This patch can corrupt older savegames that were made in the first part of Chapter 3 (Wilbur below Seastone). Savegames in the Steam cloud cannot be deleted, but only overwritten! If you experience unusual loading times with an older save game, please restart the chapter and overwrite the save game. Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Early Access - Update #3 released featuring Orchestral Music & Side Quest!
notes.content:
CHANGELOG
- Big optional side-quest added (have a look at the library at the end of Wilbur’s segment)
- Orchestral music! Thanks again to our Kickstarter-Backers!
- New, additional music tracks
- Inventory can be opened with middle mouse button, as suggested by the community

Fixed:
- Music bug & updated fanfares
- Some problems with the bird bath and the fishing hat
- A bug where it was impossible to right click examine the troll
- The interaction icon of the file cabinet
- A wrong right click examine on the main door once all tasks were completed
- Tweaked several scenes, jumping animations, movement targets and click objects
- Credits in the main menu are functional

Tips:
- If you are still unable to combine the bellows with the machine please examine the plans of the machine in your inventory. 
- Problems running Bout2 on a notebook? - If your notebook has two graphic cards installed, please make sure that the game uses the gaming-card, not the on-board card; depending on the notebook, this can be changed by right clicking on the icon of the game, to change which card is used to run the game, or via the graphic card preferences, by determining that BoUT2 is to be started using the gaming-card; Normally this should happen automatically, but sometimes the game's not recognized by the system;
- Problems with a particular graphic card (Intel HD)? - We ran a Unity-update, this may have solved some problems with certain types of cards. Unfortunately we can't test every card there is, so if you had problems, please try again and let us know if you are still experiencing issues.

notes.title: Early Access - Update #2 released!
notes.content:
Changelog Bout 0.1.1

-          Controller input is only displayed in settings if a controller is connected.
-          Fixed some problems with the mouse cursor.
-          Hotspots move correctly if the hotspot button is released.
-          Fixed some problems with the inventory on controller input.
-          Fixed some walk / animation synchronization problems.
-          Updated the steam cloud savegame quota.
-          Fixed some missing sound effects.
-          Fixed path finding problems with the tutorial robot.
-          Fixed textures in section 3, Palace_Bedroom.
-          Optimized textures in section 1,  Harbor_Cutified.
-          Tweaked navigation and click regions in some scenes.
-          Adjusted some pouring animations.
-          Tweaked the waves in Palace_Garden.
-          Fixed a condition that could cause Cheep-Cheep to disappear.
-          Fixed a bug that allowed you to fill the bird bath with an empty flask.
-          Fixed a problem with the doily and the troll.
-          Fixed problems with the fire machine that could lead to a dead end.
-          Fixed some typos.

Note: 
There seem to be problems with some Intel HD graphics cards and the high quality setting. If you are unable to launch the game, please try the following:
-          Hold down the ALT key while the game starts until a configuration dialog appears
-          In The dialog select ‘low’ or ‘medium’ in graphics quality
-          Restart the game

notes.title: Early Access - Update #1 released!
notes.content:
Based on your feedback we’ve just released a small update. A larger update will be release end of next week.

The changes are:
- The debug menu has been removed
- The settings screen now works correctly if the game is played with a gamepad
- You can start the game in controller-mode by pressing “A” after launching the game (when you see the closed book)
- The selected speech language will be saved correctly
- We fixed some typos

We are looking forward for more feedback from you!
